# Gramlot 0.2.18

- Add page-local publish, subscribe and unsubscribe, declarative subscribe/selfsubscribe handlers, and Source-node publication. Controllers, formulas and RPC reuse their existing execution and cleanup pipeline.
- Resolve direct authored Source/DOM references from Python and JavaScript at execution time, including after a confirmation dialog. Live references stay local and cannot cross RPC/frame transport.
- Add direct parent/child publication through postMessage with typed payloads, origin/session checks and explicit readiness. Local subscribers run before forwarding.
- Add native ask dialogs for button actions and providers, with basic fields, conditions, cancellation and temporary Source/Data cleanup.
- Share the optional inspector with the Chrome extension through separate inspector and agent package entries. Add Styles, live CSS variable editing, reset and CSS download while retaining Data/Source editing and breakpoints.
- Expand the practical quick start, CSS/theme guide and messaging documentation. The examples package provides Python-first messaging lessons and a compact inspector icon.

Qualification includes the full JS/Python suites, shared inspector tests, Chromium/WebKit messaging and dialog checks over HTTP/file origins, ordinary-HTTP shipped-runtime checks, and Chrome-extension browser checks. Safari and Google Chrome applications were not separately qualified. No general widget framework, recursive frame broadcast, server/user messaging or combined remote node addressing is introduced.
